r20-1-055.gate_key: conj_b2 | B2.2 | gap | Sales fell. ___, we have decided to close the shop. |

item.q: Sales fell. ___, we have decided to close the shop.
item.why: *Therefore* introduces a result. *Whereas* contrasts two facts, *despite* needs a noun, *in case* is about something that may happen.
item.why_lv: *Therefore ievada sekas.* *Whereas pretstata* divus *faktus*, aiz *despite* jābūt lietvārdam, *in case* ir par to, kas var *notikt*.

item.why: Before *to* + verb only *whether* is possible: *whether to expect us*. *if we're late* is a condition: they keep the room for us only in that case.
item.why_lv: Saka *whether to expect us*, nevis *if to expect us*. *if we're late* ir nosacījums (ja): viesnīca gaidīs vienīgi tad.
